sampling: SHA256(seed|bank|account), first 8 bytes unsigned big endian modulo 100 == 0; retain all incident rows for selected anchors; score outgoing anchor rows only. No label-conditioned sampling.
unit: publisher bank/account pair; never inferred customer identity
split_rule: Weakly connected components of the retained incident graph. Representative is lexicographically smallest bank/account tuple. SHA256(split_seed|representative), first byte modulo 2: 0 DEV, 1 HELDOUT. No rebalancing after looking at labels.
time_semantics: half-open target intervals; source timezone unspecified; historical amount strictly before target; velocity includes all records at target timestamp, consistent with native timestamp semantics
history: Only incident rows at or before target timestamp. January-only history is left-censored relative to native 90-day amount window. Full observed history for sampled anchors is retained; no negative downsampling.

signals.account_velocity_24h: Count same sending bank/account in [target minus 24h, target], inclusive of tied timestamps. Account-unit adaptation of existing CUSTOMER-level formula, not a direct native baseline. Unknown if any paid amount in the window is missing or negative; direction semantics unsupported.
signals.account_amount_multiple_observed_history: Paid amount divided by mean prior paid amounts for same sending bank/account in trailing 90 days. Unknown for no history, missing values, mixed currencies, Unknown currency or zero mean. Left-censored diagnostic only, not full 90-day/native customer result. Unknown if target or prior-history paid amount is negative; source signed-amount semantics unsupported.

native_compatibility.customer_amount_and_velocity: NOT DIRECTLY EVALUABLE: customer/account ownership absent; account-unit adaptation explicitly separate
native_compatibility.beneficiary_age: NOT EVALUABLE: beneficiary creation timestamps absent
native_compatibility.graph_cycle_and_chain: NOT DIRECTLY EVALUABLE: sampled ego graph omits unsampled-node outgoing edges; native schema lacks as-of cutoff. Do not score missing paths as negatives. Record reciprocal-cycle witnesses and missing-graph coverage separately, with no native performance claim.

direction: HIGHER for both account adaptations, fixed from existing signal protocol
metrics: precision and recall at top 1% review capacity, ceil(n*0.01), ties by source row
TP FP FN TN at that capacity
uncertainty: 200 fixed-seed component bootstrap replicates for AUC/AP when at least 10 evaluable graph components and at least 2 positive-bearing components; otherwise intervals NOT ESTIMABLE. Report positives/negatives/components. No iid transaction CI that ignores graph dependence.
missing_values: Never imputed; unknowns excluded from ranking metrics with denominators and reasons reported
duplicate_policy: Preserve original records. No transaction ID exists, so exact field duplicates need not be duplicate business events. Same-account/time duplicates necessarily share split and target window. Conflicting labels separately reported.
leakage_limits: No observed node or edge crosses component splits. Unobserved edges outside retained graph and hidden common customer ownership may connect components: full-source graph/customer independence is NOT established. No trained model, threshold fitting or risk classification is authorized.
label_semantics: IBM generator illicit-origin funds indicator, including transitive transfers; not a legal/regulatory determination
scenario_metrics: NOT AVAILABLE: no scenario IDs in original CSV; payment format is not laundering scenario
freeze_rule: Commit protocol and code before scoring. Persist sample, split and output SHA256. Do not tune to heldout or silently replace this protocol.
amendment: Before any financial metric measurement: source scan discovered signed amounts with undocumented direction semantics. Preserve them; exclude affected signal values as unknown, never negate or impute. Sampling, splits, directions and metrics unchanged from v2.0.
